Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a RAP-MS (RNA Affinity Purification coupled to Mass Spectrometry) study. The primary biological variables are the use of specific vs control probes and the treatment of cells with Nutlin-3a or HU to induce stress. While genetic perturbations (siRNA/shRNA) are mentioned in the text, they were used for RNA-seq and FISH, not for the MS dataset PXD015158.
